gallery.description:
Zhang Qian leaving emperor Han Wudi around 130 BCE, for his expedition to Central Asia. Mural in Cave 323, Mogao Caves, high Tang Dynasty, circa 8th century CE.
Rong Xinjiang (2013). Eighteen Lectures on Dunhuang, translated by Imre Galambos, BRILL, ISBN 978-90-04-25233-2, p. 52.

gallery.title: File:120706-F-UZ487-010 (7602131104).jpg
gallery.description: CAMP MIKE SPANN, Afghanistan – Afghan National Army Soldiers from the 209th Corps prepare to welcome Afghan Maj. Gen. Mussa Wardak, the ANA surgeon general, July 6 at the entrance to the hospital here. When the general’s car passed through the gate the troop stood at attention and saluted. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. James Bolinger)

gallery.filename: Students at the Baktash Secondary School during a visit from Regional Support Command-North Female Engagement Team (6216598765).jpg
gallery.title: File:Students at the Baktash Secondary School during a visit from Regional Support Command-North Female Engagement Team (6216598765).jpg
gallery.description: Shown are students at the Baktash Secondary School in Mazar-e-Sharif, Afghanistan, during a visit Sept. 12 from the Regional Support Command-North Female Engagement Team and Minnesota National Guard deployed to Regional Command-North. The classrooms, while austere, provide the all-female student body with an opportunity to become educated, something unheard of under Taliban rule and a sign of progress in the country. (Air Force photo by Tech. Sgt. Mike Andriacco)

gallery.description: Sgt. 1st Class Christina Hill, the communications section noncommissioned officer in charge for the 530th Combat Sustainment Support Battalion, 101st Sustainment Brigade, talks with Wali Shah, the sub governor for the Dehdadi district after a monthly shura. The 530th CSSB meets monthly with the local government and village elders of Dehdadi to discuss ways to improve the region.

gallery.filename: Camp Shaheen Regional Hospital treats everyone (4692739432).jpg
gallery.title: File:Camp Shaheen Regional Hospital treats everyone (4692739432).jpg
gallery.description: Mazar-E-Shariff-  Patients await departure in the recovery ward at Camp Shaheen Regional Hospital June 9, 2010. The hospital is the only known medical facility in Afghanistan to support Afghan National Army, Afghan National Police and National Dept. of Security along with the local population. (U.S. Air Force photo/Staff Sergeant Matt Davis)
